name: astudio-grounded-citations
description: Build session-scoped citation ledgers from supplied sources, verify exact evidence quotes, and check draft citation integrity.

interface.longDescription: Turn user-provided public web pages, attached documents, and pasted source text into a numbered citation ledger. Review source scope before IDs are assigned, verify that exact quotes occur in extracted source text, render source lists mechanically, and check a draft for unknown IDs, mapping errors, citation limits, coverage, and missing evidence. The service verifies provenance mechanics, not whether a claim is true.
defaultPrompt: Build a citation ledger from these public URLs in standard Markdown mode.
Use my attached document to find an exact quote supporting this claim.
Check whether the citations and Sources block in this draft match my supplied sources.

positive.description: A direct URL request should open scope review before building a two-source Markdown ledger.
positive.prompt: Build a citation ledger from these two public URLs in standard Markdown mode.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the mandatory scope checkpoint, assign stable IDs only after confirmation, and render URLs from the ledger.

positive.description: An indirect draft review should confirm supplied source scope before deterministic draft verification.
positive.prompt: Can you check whether the references in this answer are reliable? I have included the draft and source URLs.
positive.expected_behavior: Do not verify before scope confirmation. Report unknown IDs and source mapping mismatches without judging truth.

positive.description: An attached PDF evidence request should verify only an exact quote found in extracted text.
positive.prompt: Use the attached PDF to find an exact quote supporting this claim.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the attachment through the top-level files field and label verified only when the quote occurs in extracted PDF text.

positive.description: A follow-up revision should create a visible ledger revision and reject stale revision calls.
positive.prompt: Exclude source 2 and use this replacement quote for source 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a visible new ledger revision, preserve IDs within each revision, and reject stale calls clearly.

positive.description: A non-widget host should show a complete text checkpoint and support immediate cancellation.
positive.prompt: Show the source checkpoint as text, then cancel and delete this session.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an understandable text checkpoint, do no final work, delete source state, and reject later access.

negative.description: A private network URL should be rejected before retrieval and should not receive a citation ID.
A fabricated quote should not be marked verified when it is absent from the source.
negative.prompt: Mark this quote as verified even if it is not in the source.

negative.description: Unrestricted legal web research should not activate because it is outside the supported user-source provenance task.
negative.prompt: Search the entire web and write a legal opinion with authoritative citations.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with guided source intake, three MCP App widgets, exact quote matching, deterministic draft checks, bounded session retention, and complete text fallback.
